items.q: What types of insurance do you offer?
items.s: Home, auto, renters, condo, landlord, umbrella, flood, business, life, Medicare, surety bonds, travel, pet, device protection and more.
items.a: If you do not see it listed, call us: we write coverage well beyond this list, and the list grows as new programmes come online.

items.q: How do I get an insurance quote?
items.s: Fill out the quote form on any page or call (816) 868-1787, and a team member follows up, usually the same business day.
items.a: A real person, not a bot, reviews what you send and follows up with your options.

items.s: Yes, quotes are free and carry no obligation.
items.a: You keep the numbers either way, and there is nothing to sign until you choose to move.

items.q: How long does it take to receive my quote?
items.s: Most quotes come back within one business day once we have your details.
items.a: More complex programmes, like business packages with several lines, can take a little longer, and we tell you when.

items.q: What information do I need to prepare?
items.s: Basic details about what you are insuring, your current coverage, and a way to reach you.
items.a: For property, that means the address and roughly when it was built; for vehicles, the year, make and model; for a business, what you do and how many people.

items.q: Can I customize my insurance coverage?
items.s: Yes; as an independent agency we compare across carriers and build the cover around your needs.
items.a: That means deductibles, limits and add-ons chosen for you, not a shelf product, because we are not tied to one carrier.

items.q: Will my information be kept confidential?
items.s: Yes; your information is used only to prepare your quotes and is handled per our privacy policy.
items.a: Nothing is shared with third parties for marketing, and nothing leaves our team except to the carriers you actually quote with.
